SELECT (SELECT MIN(s.releaseDate) FROM main.sets AS s) AS earliest,
       (SELECT MAX(s.releaseDate) FROM main.sets AS s) AS latest,
       COUNT(*) - COUNT(c.manaCost) AS null_costs,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE TRIM(c.manaCost) = '') AS blank_costs,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.manaCost = '{0}') AS printed_zero_costs,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.manaCost IS NOT NULL AND c.manaCost NOT LIKE '%{%') AS non_symbol_costs,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT TYPEOF(c.convertedManaCost)) AS value_types
FROM main.cards AS c;

arguments.sql:
WITH first_printing AS (
    SELECT s.code, s.name, s.releaseDate
    FROM main.sets AS s
    WHERE s.releaseDate IS NOT NULL
      AND s.code IN (
          SELECT c.setCode
          FROM main.cards AS c
          WHERE c.name = 'Abyssal Horror'
      )
    ORDER BY s.releaseDate ASC, s.code ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
latest_set AS (
    SELECT s.code, s.name, s.releaseDate
    FROM main.sets AS s
    WHERE s.releaseDate IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY s.releaseDate DESC, s.code ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
selected_sets AS (
    SELECT code, name, releaseDate FROM first_printing
    UNION
    SELECT code, name, releaseDate FROM latest_set
)
SELECT s.name AS set_name,
       ROUND(
           100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (
               WHERE c.manaCost IS NOT NULL AND c.convertedManaCost <= 3
           ) / NULLIF(COUNT(c.id), 0),
           2
       ) AS percentage
FROM selected_sets AS s
LEFT JOIN main.cards AS c ON c.setCode = s.code
GROUP BY s.code, s.name, s.releaseDate
ORDER BY s.releaseDate, s.code
LIMIT 2
